children: has explored a potential deal with Evonik
this year, according to Dealreporter story on Monday, which cited three people familiar with the matter.
Discussions between the German chemical makers have taken place, though the situation is difficult to read, according to one of the sources.
One source downplayed the possibility of a deal as BASF is “cash constrained” and will get the Agricultural Solutions IPO completed before it does an acquisition.
Last Monday, BASF said it mandated Citi
as global coordinators for the planned IPO of its Agricultural Solutions business. The IPO is targeted for mid-2027.
